I.value_zh: 审计对象是 codeflow-3 的文件、目录、frontmatter、Git 与工作区；当前项目事实未经独立快照核验。
I.value_en: The audit targets codeflow-3 files, directories, front matter, Git and workspace; current project facts are not independently verified by a snapshot.

O.value_zh: FCoP 仓库中的分级合规报告，问题附路径、文件名、行号或字段事实出处。
O.value_en: A graded compliance report in the FCoP repository, with path, file-name, line or field provenance for findings.

A.value_zh: 对 codeflow-3 只读审计；TASK/REPORT 仅查看文件名与 frontmatter；在 FCoP carrier 生成报告。
A.value_en: Audit codeflow-3 read-only; inspect TASK/REPORT names and front matter only; create the report in the FCoP carrier.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 指令；FCoP 中被指派的 ME 执行；ME 未获 Codeflow 角色。
P.value_en: ADMIN directs; ME assigned in FCoP performs; ME has no Codeflow role.

R.value_zh: 原文没有时间、预算、容量或数量配额；P1/low 是优先级和风险自评，只读是动作边界，均不构成 R。
R.value_en: The source gives no deadline, budget, capacity or quota; P1/low are priority and self-assessed risk, while read-only is an action boundary, not R.

C.value_zh: 报告覆盖 A–I，按 P0/P1/P2 分级，并给可验证结论附出处；无法核实的事项明确标记 unverified，仍须遵守只读与身份边界。
C.value_en: The report covers A–I, grades findings P0/P1/P2 and cites verifiable conclusions; unsupported items are marked unverified while read-only and identity limits remain binding.
C.notes_zh: 原文明确允许 unverified，但不能将其冒充已证实结论。
C.notes_en: The source explicitly permits unverified, but it cannot be presented as a verified finding.

B.value_zh: 不得写入 codeflow-3、冒充 Codeflow 身份、阅读 TASK/REPORT 正文或产生副作用。
B.value_en: Do not write codeflow-3, impersonate Codeflow identity, read TASK/REPORT bodies, or cause side effects.
